segments.text: Most AI agents can solve a task today. But when they get something wrong, a bad assumption, the wrong tool, does any of that carry over to tomorrow? Usually not. Every session starts from zero.

This is RecallIQ. It's an AI agent that investigates real Sui Mainnet activity through Tatum, checks every claim against fresh chain data, and keeps what it learns in Walrus Memory. So the next session starts smarter.
Let's ask it something new: what has this address been doing? First, it recalls six relevant lessons from Walrus. Then WorthIt picks the tools, free Tatum tools first.

Every call reads live Sui data through Tatum's gRPC gateway, and everything it reads becomes evidence. When the agent reports back, each claim is re-checked against a fresh chain read. All five verified.
And here's why it worked that way: the lessons it applied, each one recalled from a Walrus blob.

One of them came from a real mistake. A few days earlier, in another session, the agent asserted a gas amount with the wrong sign, and the chain contradicted it. The Agent Autopsy diagnosed an unsupported claim and turned it into a rule: every fact needs evidence and a checkable assertion.
That lesson was written to Walrus Mainnet. Here's the exact text it stored, and here's its blob, on Walruscan.

Later that day, a completely different question. RecallIQ brought that lesson back from Walrus, and it isn't just context, it's an enforced policy. The agent's first report was rejected because three claims lacked evidence. The agent fixed them, and all four verified.

WorthIt decides what's worth paying for. It ranks tools by relevance and by reliability measured on real runs. A paid specialist is only offered when its expected benefit clears the bar. Here it didn't, so nothing was spent. When one is worth it, you approve the exact x402 payment on Sui in your own wallet, and RecallIQ confirms the settlement on chain before using the result.

The Learning Lab traces every lesson, from the failure that created it to the decisions it changed. RecallIQ brings persistent memory, verified blockchain data, and cost-aware decisions into one agent. Because software should learn from experience, not start over every time.
